status: non-canonical training scenarios; not Episode 1 story missions

missions.title: BREAKWATER
missions.brief: Protect the beacon. Intercept eight drones before they destroy it. Hold A to fire; release A to turn.
missions.debrief: Defense drill complete. The beacon is secure. Record your resume code.

missions.title: DEAD CIRCUIT
missions.brief: Destroy three relay towers. Their amber cores take four hits. Keep moving between attack runs.
missions.debrief: All relay targets disabled. Attack runs logged.

missions.title: LIFELINE
missions.brief: Recover three green pods across the world, then return to the blue pad in the northwest. Follow both target arrows.
missions.debrief: Rescue drill complete. All three pods recovered.

missions.title: SAFE PASSAGE
missions.brief: Escort the blue transport east, south, east, then south across the hangar. Stay close and intercept drones.
missions.debrief: Transport reached the end of its route. Escort logged.

missions.title: HIGH WATER
missions.brief: Survive for 35 seconds. B boosts through danger. Collect green repair cells dropped by drones.
missions.debrief: Endurance drill complete. Flight telemetry recorded.

missions.title: BLACKOUT
missions.brief: Approach each relay and hold B to disable it. Stay close until the channel completes. Weapons cannot damage these relays.
missions.debrief: Three relays shut down. Sabotage drill complete.

missions.title: INTERCEPT
missions.brief: Intercept the marked heavy drone before time expires. Hold A to lock your firing direction while you move.
missions.debrief: Target intercepted before the time limit.

missions.title: SECOND WATCH
missions.brief: Defend the beacon against twelve drones. Midpoint checkpoints preserve the fight, your hull and the objective.
missions.debrief: Second defense drill complete. Beacon telemetry saved.

missions.title: SLIPSTREAM
missions.brief: Touch four navigation gates in sequence. The next gate glows green. Boost past pursuers and stay in bounds.
missions.debrief: All four gates passed. Evasion drill complete.

missions.title: FAULT LINE
missions.brief: Destroy three hardened relay targets while drones defend them. Use the seawall structures as cover.
missions.debrief: Hardened targets disabled. Strike drill complete.

missions.title: LAST LIGHT
missions.brief: Hold the hangar for 45 seconds. Alternate fire and boost. Repairs restore two hull points, up to six.
missions.debrief: Hangar endurance test complete. Final drill unlocked.

missions.title: HEAVY WEATHER
missions.brief: Find the heavy drone in the southeast. Follow the target arrows. Its attack pattern changes as its hull falls.
missions.debrief: Heavy drone defeated. All twelve training drills are complete. Episode 1 story integration follows.
